rd.researchQuestion: Can protected text and editable fields on a character grid keep native input semantics, explicit capacity, labels, and non-color state cues without becoming simulated controls?
rd.technicalUncertainty: Whether fixed-cell fields can meet the 44px target guideline, forced-colors survival, and deterministic Tab/Shift+Tab order using only native HTML and CSS.
